0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home, 1-0 on the road) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home) for the Magic's fourth game of the season, with Orlando 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, after a W1 streak. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Toronto, third in the Atlantic and 5th in the East, is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost the season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
